env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided only for Lake/Elan discovery; Lean, Lake, Bubblewrap, Python, Git, and Bash identities are hash-checked
env_allowlist.HOME: runner-provided only for Lake/Elan discovery; each Lean sandbox uses a fresh temporary HOME

network_enforcement: The outer Python validator is not network-isolated, so the conforming whole-recipe policy cannot be denied. No network access is requested or used; every Lean subprocess runs through Bubblewrap with a read-only host root, one writable fresh temporary module directory, --unshare-net, --clearenv, a fresh HOME, fixed C.UTF-8 locale and UTC timezone, umask 022, and one Lean worker thread. Existing pinned compiled dependencies are reused read-only; Lake is used only to locate Lean and LEAN_PATH.
scope_boundary: Fresh trust-zero temporary outputs with network denied for Lean subprocesses against existing pinned compiled dependencies. Covered obligation IDs identify provisional observations and assurance subjects, not accepted closure credit. The exact root still requires M0814-L-MAX-ATTAIN and M0814-T-EQUAL-CUT; complete transitive provenance/TCB, cold empty-cache offline restoration, and distinct signed independent verification remain fail-closed.
